falsification.contradiction_rule: A qualified run may STOP the registered experimental realization under the frozen STOP gate. Persistent principle-dead-end certification additionally requires preregistered statistical resolution/equivalence adequate for the population-level claim.

failure_update_rules.execution-invalid: repair execution only; preserve the scientific contract and do not update principle belief
failure_update_rules.design-nonidentifiable: repair substrate/task/variation so the principle becomes testable; do not register a principle negative
failure_update_rules.operationalization-failure: repair the measurement, representation, or objective bridge before retesting the same principle
failure_update_rules.assumption-violation: revise the omitted assumption or scope condition, derive a new prediction, and keep the core mechanism unresolved
failure_update_rules.matched-simplification: weaken or merge the current method realization/novelty claim; do not automatically reject the broader principle
failure_update_rules.registered-prediction-contradicted: only after all falsification preconditions hold may the registered prediction be rejected; persistent dead-end still requires a positive counter-explanation
